name: capacity-parent-journal-scope
title: Legacy capacity 同步观察内完整 parent journal 解码复用
constraints: Incremental tests only; no production, model, service or shared database access
Retain all complete byte/hash, retirement/parent and source before/after observations
Only existing JointJournal exact-byte decoding reuse within one synchronous observation
No current authority, SQL, Task, claim, Git or READY cache; no cross-request lifetime
Clear local decoded models on normal and exceptional exits
rollback: Restore prior parent journal construction while execution is idle; preserve all durable facts.
